models.X: singular canonical cuboid surface over C with 48 isolated A1 nodes
models.exceptional_divisor: E = union_i E_i, one exceptional component over each A1 node
models.carrier_on_resolution: hypothetical geometrically integral irreducible Gamma subset S with class V6 and geometric genus 1
models.canonical_image: B = pi(Gamma), an integral curve because the V6 carrier is not an exceptional component
models.normalization: N -> Gamma and N -> B use the common normalization of the birational integral curves

replayed_bijective_normalization_exclusi.one_nonminimal_impossible_replay: 372 > 368, so under global bijectivity every met-node branch must be the minimal FSM cusp type
replayed_bijective_normalization_exclusi.scope: Stage32EX1 candidate only; no Stage32 MAIN authority transfer

node_fiber_contract.definition: r_i = number of normalization points in N mapping to the canonical-model node x_i
node_fiber_contract.local_intersection_lemma: For an actual V6 strict transform Gamma not containing E_i, every normalization branch over x_i has positive intersection order with E_i; summing branch orders gives Gamma.E_i=m_i, hence r_i <= m_i.
consequences: m_i=1 implies r_i=1 and node x_i cannot be a nonbijective normalization fibre
r_i>=2 is possible only when m_i>=2

branch_1.name: SURFACE_NODE_FIBRE
branch_1.reason: global nonbijectivity over a surface node requires r_i>=2, hence m_i>=2

branch_2.name: SMOOTH_AMBIENT_LOCUS_CURVE_MULTIBRANCH_SINGULARITY
branch_2.reason: pi is an isomorphism over X_reg, so r_x>=2 is exactly multibranch noninjectivity of the strict transform away from E

normalization_nonbijectivity_location_pa.exhaustiveness_reason: Every point of X lies in the disjoint union Sing(X) or X_reg; X has only the 48 isolated A1 singularities in the source-locked model.

strict_transform_delta_ledger.delta_exceptional_locus: delta_E = sum delta_p over singular p of Gamma lying on E
strict_transform_delta_ledger.delta_off_exceptional_locus: delta_U = sum delta_p over singular p of Gamma lying in S minus E
strict_transform_delta_ledger.reason_for_separation: Distinct smooth points of Gamma meeting the same E_i may be identified by pi at x_i; that creates a multibranch fibre of N->B without creating a singular point of Gamma on S.
strict_transform_delta_ledger.unibranch_singularities_warning: A unibranch singularity of Gamma may contribute positive delta while the normalization fibre has one point, so AH nonbijectivity does not account for all of the total delta 472.
